description: ACT-SEL-03 and ACT-SEL-04 (a second process standing in for a callback), missing variant: rows changed, inserted and deleted by a peer while a statement is frozen inside ACE. Participant a runs UPDATE Big SET V = V + 1, Pad = String(100, 'q') over 65,536 rows with dbFailOnError; participant b suspends a 400 ms after a starts the statement, then (a frozen) runs on its own shared Database: UPDATE Big SET V = -1 WHERE ID = 60000, INSERT INTO Big (ID, V, G, Pad) VALUES (100000, 7, 0, 'new'), DELETE FROM Big WHERE ID = 65000, and snapshot reads of ID 0 and 60000, each with dbFailOnError and Errors read; then b resumes a. a reports its RecordsAffected and Errors; afterwards Count(*), Sum(V), Min(V), Max(V), the rows with V <> 1 and ids 60000, 65000, 100000 are read. Asks what a second process can do to rows and keys while a statement is mid-flight and what the statement then reports. Follow-up probe (round 2) for ACT-SEL-03, ACT-SEL-04, SQL-ACT-FAIL; works on a fresh writable copy of fixture r-q2-expr-sql-big. Each DAO statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
